# Spike 01 — info + password login

Base URL: http://localhost:3000

## #1 GET /api/v1/info (as documented in WRAPPER_PROMPT.md)
Status: 404, latency: 87ms — **404, does not exist at this path**

> Root cause (confirmed in rc-fork source, `server/api/default/info.ts`): this route is registered via `API.default.get('info', ...)`, mounted at **`/api/info`**, not under the `/api/v1/` namespace. The wrapper prompt's documented path is wrong for Rocket.Chat 8.8.x — retested below at the real path.
